svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given the seeded list, with "To do" reading 5; beat 1: you delete an open task → the delete is a soft archive — an Undo appears and "To do" still reads 5 until the undo window passes; nothing is lost on a mis-click
